promptCommon:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: CitySim source building sprite, one logical Industrial identity.
Input images: Image 1 is the frozen CitySim style anchor; Image 2 is the residential calibration source for material/detail scale; Image 3 is the registration template for camera/pivot composition.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key field only, with no ground plane or environmental background.
Style/medium: richly detailed realistic hand-painted city-builder raster illustration, warm readable materials, not voxel, toy-like, flat-vector, or raw 3D-render output.
Composition/framing: one centered building only on a 1536 x 1024 authoring canvas; fixed orthographic 2:1 isometric camera at the canonical single angle; generous transparent-ready padding; ground contact near registration pivot [768,896].
Lighting/mood: northwest key light with controlled southeast contained contact/cast shadow, industrial daylight.
Constraints: unique architecture for this logical identity; appearance only; no roads, parcels, district tiles, sidewalks, extra buildings, readable text, UI, selection marks, construction states, agents, vehicles, logos, watermarks, frame-edge subject pixels, perspective convergence, rotation, mirroring, or cropped shadow. Keep the entire subject inside the canvas with clean flat magenta around it. Use references only for style, camera, light, registration, and material vocabulary; do not copy their building.
Make the silhouette, roofline, entrance rhythm, and material rhythm materially different from every other Industrial identity. No text anywhere.

references.role: residential calibration source for material/detail scale

normalization.cleanupCommand: PLAY-096 exact Integration-published harness only; not run
